title: The Tent Peg and the Sword

request.style: English, Female solo voice with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, timpani, solemn and powerful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Israel cried out to the Lord in distress
Oppressed for twenty years by iron chariots
Sisera commanded the army of Jabin
Cruelty ruled from Hazor to the plain

[Pre-Chorus]
Deborah called Barak to Mount Tabor
Ten thousand men from Zebulun and Naphtali
The Lord would draw Sisera to Kishon
And give the enemy into their hand

[Chorus]
Sisera fled on foot in the night
To the tent of Jael the Kenite
She said turn aside and do not fear
And covered him with a blanket

[Verse]
He asked for water but got milk
In a bowl fit for a prince
But her hand reached for the tent peg
And her right hand for the hammer

[Chorus]
Sisera fled on foot in the night
To the tent of Jael the Kenite
She said turn aside and do not fear
And covered him with a blanket

[Bridge]
She struck Sisera and crushed his head
Shattered and pierced his temple
At her feet he sank and fell
And there he lay dead

[Chorus]
Sisera fled on foot in the night
To the tent of Jael the Kenite
She said turn aside and do not fear
And covered him with a blanket

[Outro]
His mother looked through the window
Wailing why the chariot is late
